jobs.title: Associate Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
We are seeking a motivated and enthusiastic
**Associate Product Marketing Manager**
to join our Intellectual Property division in
**London.**
You will support the go-to-market strategy and execution for new product launches, helping to develop positioning and messaging, creating content, and enabling our sales teams to effectively communicate the value of our
**Intellectual Property solutions**
, spanning trademarks, patents, designs, and IP data and analytics.
  
  
In this role, you'll work closely with product, sales, and marketing teams to support the launch of new enhancements and solutions and contribute to revenue growth. You will help analyze market dynamics, customer needs, and the competitive landscape to position Clarivate as a trusted partner to IP professionals, law firms, and corporate IP teams. This role requires a hands-on, execution-focused approach within a cross-functional environment, with guidance and mentorship from experienced product marketers.
  
  
**About You – Experience, Education, Skills, And Accomplishments**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant work experience
* 2–3 years of experience in Product Marketing, Product Management, or a related marketing, consulting, or business strategy role
* Exposure to, or experience contributing to, go-to-market plans and product launches
* Experience supporting the creation of product messaging, value propositions, and customer-facing marketing assets
* Experience creating both long-form and short-form thought leadership and product-related content

**It would be great if you also had…**
  
  

* Experience or knowledge of intellectual property (trademarks, patents or designs) or legal industry
* Exposure to B2B marketing in software, data, or analytics products, ideally serving legal or IP professionals
* Experience working in a global or multi-national organization

**What will you be doing in this role?**

* Support the development of product-specific messaging and positioning to differentiate our IP products and services in the market.
* Assist in implementing product marketing plans that support business growth and market expansion.
* Collaborate with the cross-functional Go-To-Market team to help plan and execute product launches, driving adoption of new features and solutions.
* Manage and create thought leadership and product-related content to drive pipeline.
* Create sales enablement materials and support multi-channel campaigns with other marketing stakeholders to attract target buyers, such as IP counsel, law firms, and corporate IP teams, and drive demand for our solutions.
* Track marketing performance metrics and share insights to help refine strategies and improve results.
* Conduct market, customer, and competitor research across the IP landscape to inform positioning and messaging.

**About The Team**
The Clarivate Product Marketing team partners closely with product, sales, and marketing to advance the category strategy and key go-to-market initiatives. As part of Clarivate’s Intellectual Property division, you’ll be part of a team focused on developing solutions that help IP professionals, law firms, and corporate innovation teams protect, manage, and grow the value of their patents, trademarks, and designs by connecting them to trusted IP data, intelligence, and AI-powered technology.
  
  
**Hours of Work**
This is a permanent, full-time position. The role is hybrid, with two days per week based in our London office. While working hours are primarily aligned with the UK time zone, some flexibility may occasionally be required to accommodate meetings with colleagues in the US or East Asia.
  
  
At Clarivate, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons with respect to hiring, compensation, promotion, training, and other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment. We comply with applicable laws and regulations governing non-discrimination in all locations.

* Proven experience planning and delivering integrated B2B campaigns, ideally in a professional services setting
* A creative thinker with strong storytelling skills, able to turn business priorities and complex subjects into campaigns with real impact
* A strong understanding of full-funnel marketing, audience segmentation and lead generation
* Hands-on experience with digital (email) and paid channels, particularly paid social (including LinkedIn) and search
* Comfortable using data to set KPIs, measure performance and report to senior stakeholders

* Experience with Salesforce, or similar marketing automation and CRM platforms

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.
  
  
Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

jobs.title: Shopper Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Here at innocent, we’re on a mission to make it easier for everyone to get more fruit and veg into their bodies. We started back in 1999 and since then we’ve gone from selling a few smoothies at a music festival to becoming one of Europe’s biggest drinks companies with around 1,000 people (and the B Corp seal of approval).
  
  
It’s nice to be able to say things like that but we’re not patting ourselves on the back just yet. We want to show everyone that it’s possible to be a successful business while looking after people and the planet too, so we’re trying to get better in pretty much every way. And that’s where this job comes in.
  
  
**The salary for this role is £57,000 to £66,000 gross per year on a full-time basis, depending on relevant experience and skills.**
How innocent shows up when someone is deciding what to buy really matters. Whether that’s in a supermarket aisle, online or somewhere in between, we want the experience to feel unmistakably innocent and help people choose our drinks.
  
  
That’s where you come in.
  
  
As our UK Shopper Marketing Manager, you’ll sit at the heart of our UK Marketing team, working closely with Sales, Category and our customer teams. You’ll turn our brand and portfolio strategy into smart, insight-led shopper plans that work for our brands, our customers and, most importantly, shoppers.
  
  
You’ll help shape our approach to shopper marketing across different channels and customers, bringing together strategic thinking and brilliant execution to keep raising the standard of how innocent shows up at the point of purchase.
  
  
**You’ll be**

* Shaping and delivering our UK shopper marketing strategy, using shopper insight to connect our brand, portfolio and commercial ambitions.
* Bringing the shopper perspective into our annual planning, translating brand priorities into clear channel, customer and activation plans.
* Spotting the occasions, barriers and opportunities that could unlock growth, and turning those insights into action.
* Setting a high bar for how innocent shows up at the point of purchase, both in-store and online.
* Turning our brand plans into distinctive shopper activation, tailored to different channels and customers.
* Working closely with Sales and Category to create customer plans that balance what’s right for our brand, shoppers and customers.
* Managing and prioritising our shopper marketing budget, using data and insight to understand what’s working and where we can do better.
* Working with our shopper marketing team, agencies and partners to turn good thinking into great execution.

**You’ll have**

* Strong experience in shopper, customer or trade marketing within fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG), alongside a good understanding of the UK grocery landscape.
* A sharp understanding of shopper behaviour and the path to purchase, across physical and digital environments.
* The ability to turn brand and commercial priorities into effective shopper, channel and customer plans.
* Strong commercial judgement and an understanding of how shopper investment can support brand, customer and business growth.
* A knack for turning data, insight and complexity into clear recommendations and compelling plans.
* Strong communication and influencing skills, with a collaborative approach and the confidence to bring different teams along with you.

**You’ll get**

* The opportunity to have a real say in how innocent shows up across UK shops and online, from the first idea through to what shoppers actually see.
* A role that gives you plenty of room to think strategically, while staying close enough to the work to make things happen.
* To work closely with Marketing, Sales, Category, Finance, Supply and our customer teams, giving you a broad view of how decisions get made across the UK business.
* The chance to deepen your understanding of shopper behaviour and turn insight into activation across different retailers, channels and occasions.
* Space to bring in fresh thinking, test new ideas and challenge how we’ve done things before when there’s a better way.
* The satisfaction of seeing your thinking come to life in the real world, from a customer plan on a screen to something a shopper actually sees in front of them.

We want innocent to be a great place to work, so we do lots of stuff to make people feel at home and try to make sure everyone’s career is shaping up the way they want it to. There are plenty of opportunities to have a go at something new or take things further.
  
  
In exchange for helping us do business in the right way, you’ll get a solid rewards package that includes private healthcare, a target-based bonus, and a bunch of other nice things like a day off on your birthday. And yes, you get free smoothies.
  
  
We also know that not all our drinkers come from the same background, or think the same – so why should we? At innocent, we want to be a great place to work where a diverse bunch of people from all backgrounds can turn up and thrive. When we hire, we want all the juice, bits, and pulp that make you who you are.
  
  
Even if you don’t think you can tick all the boxes, if the job sounds right for you, come and throw your hat in the ring.
  
  
Probably best to get your skates on though, as we might close this early if we get loads of applications.

**About Dream Money**
Dream Money is an early-stage financial venture within the Dream ecosystem, alongside HelpBnk and Simon Squibb's wider platform.
  
  
We're building a product to help people take the next step towards their ambitions. We're looking for a Marketing Manager to help shape our launch, bring our first customers on board and build the foundations for sustainable growth.
  
  
**The role**
You'll own the Dream Money marketing plan and its execution, from now through launch in May 2027 and beyond. This is a permanent role.
  
  
That means building and filling the waitlist, running the launch campaign, and turning that demand into opened accounts at a cost that makes sense. You'll have real distribution to work with: Simon Squibb's audience, HelpBnk's users, our high-profile backers and the wider Dream ecosystem.
  
  
This is a hands-on role. You'll set the plan and build the campaigns: writing copy, briefing creative, analysing results and working with product on onboarding and activation. You'll manage our social hire and work closely with the group brand team.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Run the launch campaign.
* Build and fill the launch waitlist.
* Turn our backers into content. Turn our interviews with investors ("backers") into social posts and Meta ads.
* Equip our advocates. Give backers and customers ready-made toolkits so they post about Dream Money every month.
* Win company deposits. Get companies to deposit with Dream Money and talk about it publicly.
* Spot creative opportunities.
* Keep us compliant.

**What You'll Own**
**Launch and acquisition**

* Develop and execute the launch and customer acquisition strategy.
* Identify priority customer segments and test propositions, messaging and offers.
* Build campaigns across owned audiences, email, creators, partnerships, referrals and paid media.
* Work with the wider Dream team to introduce Dream Money at relevant moments across the ecosystem, including in-person activations and accelerators.
* Own channel budgets and scale activity based on customer quality and cost per account.

**Conversion and activation**

* Build and optimise landing pages, waitlist journeys and launch campaigns.
* Work with product to improve the journey from registration through onboarding to first meaningful use.
* Find where customers drop off and run experiments to remove friction.
* Make sure campaign promises match the product experience.

**Lifecycle and retention**

* Build segmented onboarding, activation, retention and reactivation campaigns.
* Create referral programmes that encourage customers to bring in others.
* Use customer research and behavioural data to improve messaging and journeys.

**Measurement**

* Set up reliable tracking, attribution and growth reporting.
* Separate campaign performance from underlying product or onboarding issues.
* Turn results into clear decisions about what to scale, improve or stop.

**Working With Others**

* Work closely with product, design, engineering, customer support and compliance.
* Coordinate freelancers, agencies and specialist support where needed.
* Build approvals and consent requirements into campaign delivery.

**What We're Looking For**

* A track record of growing a company from launch or an early stage.
* Evidence of setting up cold acquisition campaigns at scale.
* Real strength in one core marketing discipline, whether content, media buying, copywriting or cold outbound. We want a specialist who can operate around their zone of genius.
* Experience prioritising channels and managing budgets against commercial outcomes.
* Confidence working with product and technical teams on tracking and customer journeys.
* The ability to move between strategy and execution: you can set the plan and build the campaign.
* Sound judgement about when to test, when to invest and when to stop.
* Clear communication, and comfort in an early-stage business where priorities evolve.

*Nice to have:*
Experience in fintech, financial services, consumer apps or subscription products would be valuable. So would experience with creators, communities, referrals or large owned audiences.
  
  
**How You'll Be Measured**

* Waitlist size.
* Accounts opened.
* Cost per account.

We'll also look at the quality of that growth: conversion from invitation to funded account, and repeat usage from early customers.
  
  
**Why join?**

* Shape an exciting early-stage financial product and its route to market.
* Work with the audience, community and distribution of the wider Dream ecosystem.
* Take real ownership of growth, with direct influence on the customer journey.
* Build the systems, campaigns and team that support the next stage of the business.

**How To Apply**
Send your CV or LinkedIn profile, plus two examples of growth work you personally owned. For each example, tell us the starting point, what you changed, the result and what you learned.
  
  

* Include your LinkedIn profile link on your CV.
* Upload your supporting work as individual files, or as one document with clickable links. Check the links work.
* Add explanatory notes to each piece of work.
